## Install

For a quick addon update, close WoW and extract the ZIP into `Interface/AddOns/` so that `Interface/AddOns/EraTalents/EraTalents.toc` exists. The merged `Data/patch-V.mpq` must match the server's data generation and comes only with `EraTalents-client-latest.zip` from the server release; install that package whenever the server is updated.

This asset contains the addon only. The server module is compiled by [mod-playerbots-portable](https://github.com/Syntax555/mod-playerbots-portable), which pins a tested commit of this branch.

See the fork's [README](https://github.com/Syntax555/azerothcore-mod-era-talents#supported-behavior) for earned-era behavior, configuration, compatibility and limits.
